other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via grouped statistics and encoding on full dataset
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes grouped feature statistics (e.g., mean and std per group) and frequency encodings on a concatenated DataFrame containing both train and test sets before splitting them. This leaks test set distributions and values into the training features.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound LightGBM pipeline with sensible hyperparameters and domain-specific feature engineering. However, the solution contains critical flaws: it introduces look-ahead bias by using randomised cross-validation on a temporal dataset, and it severely leaks test set information into the training data by computing grouped statistics and frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets before splitting.
